meta.status: complete first pass: all 39 platform rows sourced; EV present for 20 rows (13 press estimates marked ~); fund attribution verified for SFF, SF2, Seventh (where named) and for Domia and Nutrisens (Eighth, ADLC); Eighth attribution for other 2023 to 2026 flagship deals inferred from vintage

platform_entries.name: Drake Software (now Taxwell)
platform_entries.seller: Founder Phil Drake (founded 1977)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered, led by Cinven's US TMT team (Chris Good, Daniel Garin)
platform_entries.notes: 'Significant investment', announced 5 Feb 2021; Nitel PR (Nov 2021) calls it a majority investment in a founder-owned business. 600+ employees, 64,000 tax professionals, 33M returns a year. TaxAct bought Nov 2022 for ~$720M and combined under Taxwell holding. No EV disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Arxada (Lonza Specialty Ingredients)
platform_entries.seller: Lonza Group AG
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Club deal: 50/50 consortium with Bain Capital; EV CHF 4.2B (~EUR 3.9B) is at the top of the range
platform_entries.notes: Announced 8 Feb 2021, closed Jul 2021. EV CHF 4.2B stated by Cinven; ~2,800 employees, 17 manufacturing sites, c. 5,300 customers. Troy add-on announced Nov 2021. 2025 to 2026 recapitalisation and amend-and-extend reported by Octus and Debtwire; no exit found as of 9 Nov 2026.

platform_entries.name: Compre
platform_entries.seller: CBPE Capital
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Financials Fund deal (SFF investment no. 2 per Cinven's Sakra release); co-control with BCI; announced Dec 2020, completed Apr 2021 so sits on the window boundary
platform_entries.notes: Cinven's Säkra release lists Compre as an SFF investment completed April 2021 in partnership with BCI. Announcement reported Dec 2020 (boundary case). Seller CBPE Capital per press (to verify). Financial terms not disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Miller Insurance Services
platform_entries.seller: Willis Towers Watson
platform_entries.outlier_reason: SFF investment no. 1 (completed Mar 2021, announced Nov 2020); co-control with GIC; on the window boundary

exit.buyer: GIC (Cinven stake sold to co-shareholder GIC)

platform_entries.notes: Acquired from Willis Towers Watson by Cinven SFF and GIC, completed March 2021 (Cinven exit release). Exit agreed 11 Dec 2023, completed Mar 2024. Headcount 640+ at entry per portfolio page; 900+ at exit.

platform_entries.name: think-cell
platform_entries.seller: Founders Markus Hannebauer and Arno Schödl (remain significant minority)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 1 Jun 2021, closed Sep 2021. Seventh Cinven Fund (Unquote). Primary from founders who keep a significant minority. Unquote: 2019 revenue EUR 88M, EBIT ~EUR 80M (EBIT used as EBITDA proxy, ~); EV 'EUR 1bn+ est' (Bloomberg). Late 2025: Bloomberg reported Arma Partners mandated for a possible ~EUR 3B sale in early 2026 (~EUR 200M recurring revenue, ~EUR 150M EBITDA now). Still in current portfolio on cinven.com as of 9 Nov 2026; no completed exit found.

platform_entries.name: Arcaplanet (with Maxi Zoo Italia)
platform_entries.seller: Permira and Winch Capital Partners (Arcaplanet); Fressnapf Group (Maxi Zoo Italia, reinvested as minority)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 25 Jun 2021, completed 9 Mar 2022. Revenue at entry: Arcaplanet >EUR 400M plus Maxi Zoo Italia >EUR 193M (2021) = ~EUR 593M combined. Headcount c. 2,000 in Mar 2022 (per 2024 exit release). Founder Michele Foppiani (CEO) continued. Exit: sale to Fressnapf agreed Jul 2024; Arcaplanet Group >EUR 700M revenue 2024. EV not disclosed (press reported ~EUR 1B+, to verify).

platform_entries.name: Restaurant Brands Iberia (now Restaurant Brands Europe)
platform_entries.sub_sector: Quick service restaurants (Burger King, Popeyes, Tim Hortons master franchisee)
platform_entries.seller: Founder Gregorio Jiménez and co-founders (remain minority) with Burger King Europe GmbH (RBI) as minority
co_investors: Restaurant Brands International (Burger King Europe GmbH), minority

exit.buyer: Consortium led by founder Gregorio Jiménez

platform_entries.notes: Announced 28 Jul 2021, closed Oct 2021. 'Valued at more than EUR 1bn', c. 14,000 employees, 500 own and 500 franchised restaurants. Cinven had held a minority since 2018 (to verify); this entry is the step-up to majority. Exit agreed 6 Nov 2026 to a consortium led by founder Gregorio Jiménez; EBITDA more than doubled under Cinven; 1,400+ restaurants.

platform_entries.name: True Potential
platform_entries.seller: Founders David Harrison (Chairman) and Daniel Harrison (CEO), hundreds of individual partners, and FTV Capital (minority)
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: GBP 1.6B to 2.0B (Sky News via PE Insights, Sep 2021; midpoint GBP 1.8B ~EUR 2.09B)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 9 Sep 2021, closed Jan 2022. Cinven: c. GBP 135M EBITDA FY2021E (~EUR 157M), >GBP 20B AuM, 350+ staff. Sky News: GBP 1.6B to 2.0B valuation (~). FY2020 turnover GBP 185M (~EUR 215M) and EBITDA GBP 74M per PE Insights. Fund not named in release; Seventh assumed (Fund 7 investing period), with SFF possibly co-investing (unverified).

platform_entries.name: BioAgilytix
platform_entries.seller: Cobepa (majority seller, re-invests significant minority)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (Durham, NC)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 17 Nov 2021, closed Dec 2021. 870 staff, five locations. Financial terms not disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Nitel
platform_entries.seller: Founders Rick Stern and Ron Grason
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (Chicago), US TMT team
platform_entries.notes: Announced 18 Nov 2021, closed Dec 2021; 'third majority investment in a founder-owned business in 2021'. Exit: Comcast Business acquisition closed 1 Apr 2025 (terms undisclosed).

platform_entries.name: Ufinet International (II)
platform_entries.seller: Sixth Cinven Fund (fund-to-fund), Enel reinvests minority
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Fund-to-fund continuation (Seventh Fund buying from Sixth Fund); operations in Latin America
platform_entries.notes: Announced 21 Dec 2021, closed Mar 2022. EV approximately EUR 2.5B stated by Cinven; c. 1,400 employees. Jul 2025 Cinven insight '10 years of transformation'; still in current portfolio.

platform_entries.name: International Financial Group Limited (IFGL)
platform_entries.sub_sector: Cross-border life insurance and savings (RL360, Friends Provident International)
platform_entries.seller: Vitruvian Partners (to verify) and management
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Financials Fund deal (SFF investment no. 3); Isle of Man regulated life insurer
platform_entries.notes: Announced 1 Feb 2022, completed Jan 2023 (long regulatory process). GBP 19B AuA, 550+ employees. Financial terms not disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Envu (Bayer Environmental Science Professional)
platform_entries.sub_sector: Environmental science / professional pest and vegetation management
platform_entries.seller: Bayer AG
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (Cary, NC) although originated by DACH and Industrials teams from Bayer
platform_entries.notes: Announced 10 Mar 2022, closed Oct 2022. EV USD 2.6B (~EUR 2.4B) per Cinven; c. 800 employees. Mar 2026: GIC took a strategic minority stake (partial sell-down; Cinven retains control).

platform_entries.name: Netceed (Euro Techno Com Group)
platform_entries.seller: Carlyle (reinvests minority); founder and CEO Cédric Varasteh retains significant stake
platform_entries.notes: Exclusive negotiations announced 3 Jun 2022, closed Oct 2022. Revenue >EUR 1B, c. 1,100 employees, c. 14,000 customers. Appears on cinven.com realised list (date Oct 2022) with no exit release found; exit status to verify.

platform_entries.name: Säkra
platform_entries.seller: Adelis Equity Partners
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Financials Fund deal (SFF investment no. 4)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 6 Sep 2022, closed Feb 2023. 350 employees, 60+ offices at entry. Still in current portfolio on 9 Nov 2026; no exit found.

platform_entries.name: group.ONE and dogado
platform_entries.sub_sector: Web hosting and online presence for SMEs
platform_entries.seller: Sixth Cinven Fund (group.ONE, fund-to-fund) and Triton (dogado, to verify)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Fund-to-fund transfer of group.ONE from Sixth to Seventh Fund combined with dogado; co-investment with Ontario Teachers'
platform_entries.notes: Announced 5 Dec 2022, closed Mar 2023. Seventh Cinven Fund named. group.ONE HQ Sweden (650+ employees, 1.6M customers), dogado HQ Germany (500+ employees). Press reported EV ~EUR 1.2B (to verify).

platform_entries.name: Master Builders Solutions (MBCC Admixtures)
platform_entries.seller: Sika AG (antitrust remedy disposal of MBCC Group admixtures)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 22 Mar 2023, closed May 2023. Remedy disposal by Sika after its MBCC Group acquisition. 2022 sales CHF 920M (~EUR 945M), 1,600+ employees, 35 sites (CHEManager). Price not disclosed. Fund: Eighth inferred from timing, unverified. Lead: Industrials (Pontus Pettersson) with DACH team.

platform_entries.name: Archer
platform_entries.seller: RSA Security (Clearlake Capital and Symphony Technology Group)
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: USD >2B sought by RSA (Reuters, Jan 2023); final price undisclosed
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (Overland Park, Kansas), led by Head of North America Julia Kahr
platform_entries.notes: Announced 13 Apr 2023, closed Jun 2023. Carve-out from RSA Security (Clearlake and STG). Reuters (Jan 2023): RSA sought 'more than USD 2 billion'; Archer revenue USD 220M in 2022 (~EUR 205M). EV recorded at ~EUR 1.85B (USD 2B at 0.92) as a press-based estimate (~, medium confidence). Fund: Eighth inferred from timing, unverified.

platform_entries.name: Amara NZero
platform_entries.seller: ProA Capital (retains minority) with chairman Pablo Arnus and CEO retaining minority stakes
platform_entries.notes: Announced 27 Apr 2023, closed Aug 2023. Revenue grown c. 65% p.a. organically since 2020 (no absolute figure). Family (Arnus) remains minority. Fund attribution to verify.

platform_entries.name: Alter Domus
platform_entries.seller: Permira funds and founders (each sells ~half their shares, retain significant stakes)
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: EUR 4.9B (press: MergerSight, Investment Officer, City AM)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 4 Mar 2024, closed Oct 2024. Cinven calls it a majority investment; founders and Permira (34% holder) each sold about half their shares and stay invested. EV EUR 4.9B per MergerSight and Investment Officer (press figure; Cinven did not disclose). ~5,000 employees. Revenue +54% since 2021; AuA USD 2.5tn. Lead: Business Services (Rory Neeson) and Financial Services (Maxim Crewe), London.

platform_entries.name: idealista
platform_entries.seller: EQT (majority seller); founder Jesús Encinar and management reinvest
platform_entries.notes: Announced 28 Jun 2024, closed Dec 2024. EV EUR 2.9B stated by Cinven. Seller EQT per press (to verify).

platform_entries.name: Fressnapf Group (minority)
platform_entries.seller: Founder Torsten Toeller (retains majority)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Minority stake in a founder-controlled group, made concurrently with the Arcaplanet exit
platform_entries.notes: Announced 4 Jul 2024, closed Dec 2024. Combined group expected ~EUR 5B gross revenue 2024, 2,600+ stores in 14 countries. Financial terms not disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Vitamin Well
platform_entries.seller: Bridgepoint (retains significant minority); co-founder Jonas Pettersson continues
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: EUR ~3.0B at ~20x EBITDA (NKP M&A Insights, Aug 2024; Bloomberg reported talks)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 6 Aug 2024, closed Oct 2024. 'Lead investor', Bridgepoint keeps a significant minority; c. 500 employees. EV ~EUR 3B and ~EUR 150M EBITDA (marketed figure) per NKP M&A Insights; both are press estimates (~). Jul 2026: EMPWR combination (add-on). Lead team: Nordic regional (Pontus Pettersson) and Consumer (Matteo Corà), London.

platform_entries.name: Finaxy Group
platform_entries.seller: Ardian (Expansion); founder-CEO Erick Berville and management reinvest significantly
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Financials Fund deal
platform_entries.notes: Exclusivity 3 Sep 2024, closed 2 Dec 2024. SFF named by Cinven. CFNEWS: valuation just under EUR 500M (~), ~EUR 100M revenue (commissions), EBITDA almost tripled in five years, Cinven stake ~54%, 330+ staff. Seller Ardian Expansion V; founder-CEO Erick Berville reinvests.

platform_entries.name: Policy Expert
platform_entries.seller: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority subsidiary (sells 50%, retains 50%)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Financials Fund deal; 50% stake alongside ADIA
platform_entries.notes: Announced 11 Sep 2024, closed Jan 2025. SFF named by Cinven; 50% from ADIA subsidiary, ADIA keeps 50%. 1.5M customers. No financial details disclosed (methods tried: Cinven release, AGBI, Insurance Times, Zawya).

platform_entries.name: Domia Group
platform_entries.seller: IK Partners (IK Small Cap)
platform_entries.notes: No Cinven press release. French competition authority decision 24-DCC-195 (16 Sep 2024): exclusive control of groupe Domia (Acadomia, Shiva) by BloCin BidCo, indirectly held by the Eighth Cinven Fund; put option letter signed 1 Aug 2024. Seller IK Partners (Mergr, CFNEWS). Below EU merger thresholds, so EU turnover under EUR 250M (method: EUMR thresholds, low confidence). Terms undisclosed. Brands: Acadomia (tutoring, 150k pupils), Shiva (home cleaning).

platform_entries.name: Grant Thornton UK
platform_entries.seller: Partnership (240+ partners remain significant shareholders)
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: GBP up to 1.5B (PE Insights, industry sources; ~EUR 1.77B at 1.18)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 21 Nov 2024, completed Apr 2025. Majority investment; 240+ partners keep a significant stake. 5,500+ employees. Valuation 'up to GBP 1.5B' per PE Insights (press, ~). Net revenue GBP 724M (FY2024, ~EUR 854M). Primary deal from a partnership (no founder). Lead: London FS and BS teams.

platform_entries.name: Nutrisens
platform_entries.seller: Sagard MidCap; founder-CEO Georges Devesa and management reinvest significantly
platform_entries.notes: Exclusivity 20 May 2025, closed Sep 2025. ADLC decision 25-DCC-159 (4 Jul 2025) names the Eighth Cinven Fund as acquirer of exclusive control (promise signed 16 May 2025). 750+ employees, 30+ countries; 20% organic growth, 8 acquisitions under Sagard. Below EU thresholds (EU turnover under EUR 250M, low confidence). Financial terms undisclosed.

platform_entries.name: Artefact
platform_entries.seller: Ardian (Ardian Expansion, majority seller; option to stay as minority); founders keep 'several tens of percent'
platform_entries.notes: Exclusivity 28 Jul 2025, closed Dec 2025 (CFNEWS op date 1 Dec 2025). ADLC 25-DCC-236: Datheos BidCo (Cinven) majority of TopSky (Artefact holding). CFNEWS: EV EUR 1.1B to 1.2B (~), 2025E revenue ~EUR 200M and EBITDA ~EUR 60M (NKP: EUR 40M 2024 EBITDA, ~25x 2024 / ~16.6x 2025E). 1,700 employees. Fund: Eighth inferred, unverified.

platform_entries.name: Smart Communications
platform_entries.seller: Accel-KKR (majority seller since 2016, retains minority)
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: GBP 1.4B / USD 1.8B (Bloomberg, 1 Aug 2025); ~20x 2025 EBITDA per NKP
platform_entries.notes: Announced 1 Aug 2025, closed Oct 2025. Bloomberg: USD 1.8B valuation (GBP 1.4B, ~EUR 1.64B at 1.17). EBITDA ~GBP 70M implied by the ~20x multiple reported by NKP (derived, ~, low confidence). 400+ employees, 650+ customers; 5x revenue growth under Accel-KKR. Lead: TMT (Thomas Railhac, Adam Prindis), London.

platform_entries.name: Objectway
platform_entries.seller: Founder Luigi Marciano (remains significant shareholder, CEO and Chair)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: First investment of Cinven's Strategic Fund 2 (mid-market strategy), a separate fund from the flagship
platform_entries.notes: Announced 7 Aug 2025, closed Nov 2025 (Aziendabanca legal note 17 Nov 2025). 'First investment from Cinven's new mid-market strategy' = SF2 (EUR 2.3B, closed Sep 2026). 250+ financial institution customers, 16+ countries. Financing from Banca Popolare di Sondrio and others. No financial terms (methods tried: Cinven, Business Wire, Aziendabanca, Freshfields).

platform_entries.name: Universidad Alfonso X el Sabio (UAX)
platform_entries.seller: CVC Funds; founder Jesús Núñez and management reinvest
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: EUR ~2B (Bloomberg Sep 2025: 'could be valued at more than EUR 2 billion', ~EUR 1B debt; InforCapital ~EUR 2B)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 28 Oct 2025, closed Jul 2026. Majority stake from CVC; founder Jesús Núñez and Mubadala co-invest. 35k students. EV ~EUR 2B is a press estimate (Bloomberg pre-deal: 'more than EUR 2 billion', up to EUR 1B debt offered), so equity ~EUR 1B shared with Mubadala and founder (method: EV less debt, low confidence). Lead: Iberia (Jorge Quemada, Madrid).

platform_entries.name: Flint Global
platform_entries.seller: Co-founders Ed Richards and Sir Simon Fraser (remain significant shareholders) and existing investors
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: GBP ~190M (Bloomberg Deals via NKP, Dec 2025); ~16x FY1 EBITDA of ~GBP 12M
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Second investment of Strategic Fund 2 (mid-market strategy)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 8 Dec 2025, completed by year end 2025. Majority investment, primary (founders Ed Richards and Sir Simon Fraser stay as significant shareholders). Bloomberg Deals (via NKP): EV ~GBP 190M (~EUR 222M at 1.17), marketed off ~GBP 12M EBITDA (~EUR 14M), ~16x; Alantra ran the process; Corinthia provided financing. Second SF2 investment.

platform_entries.name: Regenity Biosciences
platform_entries.seller: Linden Capital Partners (remains as partner)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (New Jersey), led by Head of North America; 'strategic investment' alongside incumbent sponsor Linden, stake undisclosed
platform_entries.notes: Announced 12 Feb 2026, closed Apr 2026. 250+ employees, 125+ customers, 80+ product lines. Stake not stated; structure is a partnership with incumbent sponsor Linden (Cinven 'adding new partner alongside Linden'), so likely co-control or significant minority. Deal type recorded as minority pending verification; no financial terms (methods tried: Cinven and Linden releases).

platform_entries.name: Ongoing Warehouse
platform_entries.seller: Co-founders Henrik Ekman and Gerhard Guron (remain significant shareholders)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Third investment of Strategic Fund 2 (mid-market strategy)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 6 May 2026, closed Jul 2026. Third SF2 investment. DNB Carnegie ran the sale process (NKP, from Sep 2025). Stake not stated explicitly; founders remain significant shareholders and SF2 targets control positions, so recorded as majority (medium confidence). Led by Michael Weber (Frankfurt, SF2 co-head) and Pontus Pettersson. No financials disclosed.

platform_entries.name: Salsify
platform_entries.seller: VC and growth investors (to verify)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: US-headquartered (Boston), US team led
platform_entries.notes: Announced 22 Jul 2026, closed Sep 2026. 2,000+ customers, 70,000 users; Moelis advised Salsify; Goodwin advised Salsify, Simpson Thacher advised Cinven. Financial terms not disclosed (methods tried: Cinven, Dealroom, Goodwin, STB releases). Dealroom lists USD 453M raised historically; sellers are existing VC and growth investors (not named). Founder involvement unknown.

platform_entries.name: Optio
platform_entries.seller: Preservation Capital Partners
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Strategic Fund 2 deal (fourth SF2 investment) and joint acquisition with La Caisse
platform_entries.notes: Announced 27 Jul 2026; not yet on the portfolio page as of 9 Nov 2026 (closing pending). Fourth SF2 investment per Cinven's SF2 close release. Insurance Times: ~GBP 460M GWP. Seller Preservation Capital Partners (exit). Founded 2018, 18 offices in 15 countries. No EV disclosed (methods tried: Cinven, NKP, Insurance Times, Reinsurance News).

platform_entries.name: Theramex
platform_entries.seller: Carlyle and PAI Partners
platform_entries.ev_source_currency_amount: GBP ~2.2B / EUR ~2.6B (pharmaphorum, Dealroom; ~EUR 1.5B debt per Bloomberg)
platform_entries.notes: Announced 3 Nov 2026; closing pending. 500+ employees, 80+ countries. Press: ~GBP 2.2B / EUR 2.6B EV (~), ~EUR 1.5B debt (Bloomberg) so ~EUR 1.1B equity including any rollover (method: EV less debt package, low confidence); Carlyle and PAI paid ~EUR 1.4B in 2022 and 'more than doubled' operating profit; analysts put revenue at USD 500M+ (~EUR 430M, low confidence). Fund assumed Eighth (flagship healthcare team), unverified.

platform_entries.name: Grant Thornton Germany
platform_entries.seller: Equity partners of Grant Thornton AG (remain significant shareholders)
platform_entries.outlier_reason: Structured as a strategic partnership closely tied to the Grant Thornton UK investment; stake not disclosed; likely managed as a sister platform to Grant Thornton UK
platform_entries.notes: Signed 10 Sep 2025; partner approval 13 Oct 2025; expected close Q1 2026 (closing date to verify). ~2,000 employees, ten offices. Not listed as a separate portfolio page on cinven.com.
